changelog:
* **fix: grey artifact in quantity sheet** (ca6063c)
  - stop window resize (adjustNothing) on API 30+ so the sheet's built-in
    imePadding alone lifts content above the keyboard; keep adjustResize on
    API 24-29 where androidx.core synthesizes IME insets only from resize
  - defer custom-field focus by one frame (withFrameNanos) so the IME opens
    after the field is laid out, not mid-sheet-relayout
  - simplify preset chips to plain clickable with indication = null and
    delete the custom NoIndication / pointerInput-detectTapGestures machinery
